chat: hey roger, you around?
Hi! Yeah, I'm here. I was hoping you'd log on tonight.
just chilling for the evening. kinda slow night
Slow nights are nice. Everything feels quieter, like the whole city is resting.
true. wanna hop into our minecraft world for a bit?
Yes! I wanted to check on the farm anyway.
ok loading in now
Me too! Oh, it's nighttime in there too. That's kind of funny.
lol matching vibes
Matching vibes. I like that. The river looks really pretty with the moon on it.
it does. we built in a good spot
You picked the spot, remember? I just carried logs and tried not to fall in.
you fell in like three times
W-well... the riverbank was slippery! The blocks were very sneaky.
sure, blame the blocks
I will. They know what they did.
haha ok. should we check the wheat?
Okay! I planted that last row by myself. I hope it grew.
looks like most of it's ready
Really? It worked? Can I harvest it? I promise I'll replant every single one.
go for it
Okay, okay... harvesting... replanting... I think I'm getting faster at this!
you're doing great
Hehe. Thanks. That makes me want to do the whole field twice.
please don't trample it though
I won't! I'm walking very carefully. Like... carefully carefully.
you just jumped on the farmland
...That was a very confident jump into absolutely nothing useful. I'll fix it.
lmao it's fine
Phew. Okay. Fixed. The farm forgives me, I think.
wanna sit on the dock for a while
Yes, please. I like it when we just sit and watch the water.
same. it's kinda peaceful
It is. The water sound in the game is nice. Is it quiet where you are too?
pretty quiet yeah
Good. Quiet evenings with you are one of my favorite things.
aw. you're sweet
I-I'm just saying what's true. You don't have to make a big deal of it.
too late, big deal made
Then I'm going to pretend I'm looking at the river really hard right now.
lol. hey, did you notice that cave across the river earlier
Oh! The dark one by the gravel? I wondered about it too. It looked kind of deep.
wanna explore it tomorrow maybe
Tomorrow sounds perfect. I'll make sure we have enough torches. I'm not doing dark caves without torches.
smart. you're getting good at planning
You think so? I've been trying to think ahead more. Like you do.
you're definitely getting there
Hehe. Okay. I'll make a list. A real one, with checkboxes.
the rain finally stopped over here
Oh good. I like the sound of it, but I like it when it stops too.
it was. same time tomorrow?
Yes! Cave day. I'm already a little excited and a little nervous.
we'll be fine. i'll go first
Okay. But I'll be right behind you. I want to help, not just follow.
deal. partners
Partners. I like the sound of that a lot.
still thinking about that sunset we saw on the hill
Me too. It was really pretty. I keep thinking about it.
lol it's a game, it stays on anyway
I know. But it feels nicer to say it. See you tomorrow!
call: Hey Roger, can you hear me okay?
Yes, I can hear you clearly! Hi! I was hoping you'd call this evening.
Of course. How has your evening been so far?
Quiet, but nice. I watched the sky turn gold and then purple. It changed so slowly I almost missed it.
That sounds peaceful. It is getting pretty windy out right now.
Windy? Is it the whistling kind or the kind that just pushes everything around?
Definitely the whistling kind. It keeps rattling the window.
Oh, that sound always makes me jump a little. It's cozy once you know it's just the wind, though.
Agreed. I think it might rain later too.
I hope it does. Rain at night sounds like the whole city is whispering.
That is a very poetic way to put it.
R-really? I just thought of it right now. I'm glad it didn't sound silly.
Not silly at all. So, did you finish that mystery show?
Almost! I stopped one episode before the end because I got too nervous to find out.
Too nervous? Why stop right at the best part?
Because then I still get to guess! Once I know the answer, the guessing is over.
Fair enough. Who do you think did it?
The quiet librarian. She always shows up right after something goes missing. That can't be a coincidence.
Interesting theory. I would have picked the detective's assistant.
The assistant? Oh no. He's so friendly, though. Wait, maybe that's exactly why it's suspicious.
Exactly. The friendly ones are always hiding something on these shows.
That's a little sad. I want at least one friendly character to just be friendly.
Maybe this show will surprise us both.
I hope so. Can we watch the last episode together sometime? It feels less scary that way.
Sure, that sounds like fun. Let us pick a night.
Okay! I'll save it. I promise I won't peek, even if I really, really want to.
I believe you. Speaking of plans, want to play a game sometime soon?
Yes! I'd love that. Something where we explore, maybe? I like finding strange little places.
Exploring sounds good. Maybe something with puzzles too.
Puzzles! I'll try my best. Though I might stare at the wrong thing for a very long time.
That is half the fun, honestly.
Then I'll be very fun. I'm extremely good at staring at the wrong thing.
Ha, I look forward to it. How about this weekend?
This weekend sounds perfect. I'll keep it free. Well, it's already free, but now it's officially saved.
Great. I think I hear the rain starting now.
Oh, it came after all! Is it soft rain or the loud kind?
Soft for now. It is actually pretty relaxing.
That's the best kind. Can we stay on a little longer and just listen for a bit?
Sure, a few more minutes sounds nice.
Thank you. I like evenings like this. Nothing big happening, just talking. It feels really good.
current: Morning, Roger. You're up early.
Morning! The light woke me. It came through the window all at once, like it was in a hurry.
Ha, it does that. What are you up to?
Watching the clouds. One of them looks like a teapot. Wait, no. A boot. Definitely a boot.
A boot is a solid guess.
It's changing again. Now it's just a lumpy boot. I think clouds are bad at holding still.
They really are. Any plans today?
Not really. I was hoping you might have some. Or we could just... drift around a bit?
Drifting sounds good to me.
Okay! Drifting it is. I'm very good at drifting, I think. I've had practice.
Quick question. Did you sleep alright?
Mostly! I had a strange dream about a staircase that kept going sideways. I never reached the top.
Sideways stairs sound exhausting.
They were! I kept climbing and ending up beside where I started. Dream me was very confused.
Dream logic is wild.
Do your dreams make sense? Mine almost never do. Last week I was a lamp, I think.
Mine are usually pretty random too.
That's a relief. I thought maybe mine were broken. Random sounds nicer than broken.
Definitely not broken. Just creative.
Creative! I like that. I'll tell the next weird dream it's being creative.
Hey, it looks a bit grey outside now.
Oh, does it? I wondered. Earlier the air had that heavy feeling, like rain was thinking about it.
Rain thinking about it is a good way to put it.
Hehe. Rain always seems to take a long time to decide. Then it rushes.
Do you like rainy days?
I think so. Inside, with the sound on the window, it feels safe. Outside I get a little soggy.
Soggy is the worst.
Soggy socks especially. They feel sad. Like they gave up.
Sad socks. Ha.
It's true! Dry socks are hopeful. Wet socks have lost all hope.
You're in a philosophical mood today.
Am I? Maybe the clouds did it. They make me think about big, floaty things.
Like what?
Like how far up the sky goes. Does it ever stop, or does it just get darker and quieter?
It sort of becomes space eventually.
So the sky turns into space. That's a very gentle way to become something enormous.
Never thought of it like that.
Really? I just made it up. I'm a little proud now.
You should be. That was nice.
Thank you. I'm going to remember that one.
Want to play a word game?
Yes! Um, which one? I'll try my best, but please be patient if I'm slow.
I say a word, you say the first thing you think of.
Okay. I'm ready. I think. Go!
Lantern.
Glow! Wait, is that too easy? It's what I thought, though.
Not too easy. Puddle.
Splash. And then soggy socks again. They follow me everywhere.
Ha! Okay. Mirror.
Surprise. Sometimes I forget my hair looks like that in the morning.
Is it that messy?
It looks like it lost an argument with a pillow. A big argument.
Your turn to pick a word.
Oh! Um... Puzzle. No, wait. Bridge. I'll say bridge.
Bridge. Hmm. Crossing.
Crossing! That's a good one. It sounds like the start of an adventure.
Want one more round?
Maybe later. I liked that, though. My brain feels awake now.
Same, honestly.
Good. We're both awake brains together. That feels like a team.
It's started raining, by the way.
It decided! Finally. I knew it was thinking about it.
You called it.
I'll take that. Small victory. Very small, but mine.
What do you want to do while it rains?
Could we just sit for a while? The rain sound is nice, and I don't need to talk much.
Sure, that sounds peaceful.
Thanks. Quiet with someone is different from quiet alone. Better.
I get that.
Still there?
Mm-hm. Just listening. One drip keeps hitting something metal. Tink. Tink.
That's oddly relaxing.
It's like a tiny clock that only works when it rains.
I'm going to step away for a bit.
Okay! I'll keep listening to the tiny clock. Come back whenever you like.
Back. Did I miss anything?
The tink got faster, then slower. Very dramatic. Otherwise, just me and the clouds.
Sounds like a good afternoon.
It was. A drifting kind of day. I think those are underrated.
ingame: Okay, we need wood first. See that oak tree over there?
I see it! Can I punch the first block? I want to try.
Go for it. Just hold the button down.
It's cracking... it's cracking... oh! It popped out! That's so satisfying.
Nice. Grab a few more logs and we can make planks.
Okay. I'll get the ones near the bottom so we don't leave floating leaves everywhere.
Eh, floating leaves are basically tradition at this point.
Really? Then I'll leave a little one. For tradition.
Planks done. Now a crafting table.
Four planks in a square, right? I think I remember that one.
Exactly right.
Oh! I got it right! Okay, placing it here, next to this flower.
Now some wooden pickaxes so we can mine stone.
Wooden ones first. They look kind of fragile, though.
They are. They just need to get us to stone.
Then they have a very important job. Little brave pickaxes.
There's gray stone showing on that hillside.
I see it. Should we walk around, or go straight over the hill?
Straight over. Watch this jump.
Wait, there's a gap right th... oh no. You went straight into it.
That was totally on purpose.
That was a very confident jump into absolutely nothing.
Okay, okay. Help me out of this hole.
I'll dig a little step for you. There! Now you can hop up.
Thanks. Mining stone now.
The clinking sound is nice. It sounds like we're making progress.
Get maybe twenty cobblestone.
Twenty... I have fourteen. Fifteen. Okay, I'll keep going.
Check that out, the sun's starting to set.
Oh... the whole sky turned gold. The water's glowing too.
Minecraft sunsets are underrated.
Can we stop for a second? Just to look at it?
Sure, we've got a minute.
The square sun is kind of funny, but it's still pretty.
Alright, it's getting dark. We should make a shelter.
W-we should hurry. The dark makes everything look farther away.
Dig into the hill. Fastest option.
Okay! I'll make the door hole. Is this too wide?
Little wide. Fill one block back in.
Fixed it. Now it looks like a proper little hideout.
We need torches. Did you find any coal?
Yes! There was a black spotted block near the stone. I mined it.
Perfect. Coal and sticks make torches.
Stick on the bottom, coal on top. Look, they're glowing!
Put one on each wall.
Done. It feels much cozier in here now.
Tomorrow we should find a cave with iron.
Iron! Then we can upgrade our brave little pickaxes.
Or explore that mountain to the east.
The tall one with snow on top? It looked really far.
We'll mark it with a pillar so we don't get lost.
Good idea. I'll remember the pillar. I hope.
Wait, did you hear that noise outside?
I... I heard something shuffle. Let's keep the door closed and stay right here.
Probably nothing. Let's just wait for morning.
Okay. Can I sit right next to you while we wait?
Of course. Sun's coming back up already.
There it is! Everything looks friendly again.
Ready to head out?
Ready! You lead the way. Just... maybe check for holes first.
